calls.prompt:
Locate this FL Studio control: use high quality
Use only visible evidence. Preserve the exact named channel, track or plugin; do not substitute Drums for Snare or assume a hidden target is visible.
Distinguish Channel Rack, Mixer, Playlist, Piano roll, Browser, toolbar, plugin windows, dialogs and menus. Match the requested function and entity.
Use coordinates from 0 to 1000 relative to the image width/height, measured from the top-left. Identify the panel and exact named entity; distinguish neighboring controls by function. Return only {"visible":boolean,"panel":"short name","entity":"short name","point":{"x":number,"y":number},"ambiguous":boolean}. Set point=null if absent. Set ambiguous=true if multiple visible controls plausibly match the request. No explanation or bounding boxes.
